verdict.rationale: The evidence pack only shows manual/custom event capture (SDK, HTTP API) and mentions building insights on 'events you already send' — it never describes an autocapture feature that records clicks, pageviews, or form submissions without instrumentation code. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of autocapture/no-code event tracking, evidence of automatic click/pageview/form capture, and any confirmation that no tracking code is required per event.
